hero.title: Fees & Commissions
hero.lead: We aim to make our commission system as transparent as possible. You always see exactly what you're paying for, how the fee is calculated, and the terms for withdrawing funds.

how.title: How fees work
how.body: A fee is only charged for successfully completed deals. If a project doesn't happen or the deal is cancelled before completion, no fee is charged.
how.customer: For clients: 0% for posting a task.
how.contractor: For contractors: the fee is charged only after a project is successfully completed.

contractor.title: Contractor fee
contractor.body: At launch, all contractors pay a single flat rate of 8%, regardless of rating or volume of completed work.
contractor.future: Discounted rates for high-rated users may be introduced in the future — we'll announce any such changes in advance.

pro.title: Pro account
pro.body: Pro account holders get a 2 percentage point discount off the standard fee. A Pro account is a paid subscription (monthly or half-yearly) that also unlocks other platform perks.
pro.soon: A detailed overview of Pro account features will be published once this feature launches.

autoclose.title: Automatic project closure
autoclose.body: Regardless of account type, a standard auto-close rule applies. If a client doesn't confirm completed work within 48 hours after the deadline, the project closes automatically and the funds are released to the contractor.

withdrawal.title: Withdrawing funds
withdrawal.body: WorkZora doesn't charge its own fee for withdrawals. However, payment providers may apply their own fees, which vary by withdrawal method.
withdrawal.methods: Withdrawals to Visa/Mastercard bank cards are currently available.
withdrawal.note: Before confirming a transaction, we recommend reviewing the terms of the relevant payment provider.

refund.title: Refunds to clients
refund.body: If funds are refunded to a client, actual non-refundable payment provider fees may be deducted from the refund amount.

currency.title: Settlement currency
currency.body: The platform's primary currency is USD. Balances and settlements are kept in dollars; amounts may additionally be shown in other currencies at the current rate for convenience.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: As the platform evolves, certain terms regarding fees and withdrawals may change. We will notify users of any material changes in advance.
